verdict.rationale: Bun writes a text-based `bun.lock` on install (bun-docs-38, bun-docs-23), and its docs state that `--frozen-lockfile` gives reproducible installs of the exact locked versions without updating the lockfile (bun-docs-35). An offline mode that never touches the network supports deterministic installs from cache (bun-docs-5). A community report of Windows install crashes possibly tied to old lockfiles (bun-comm-13) is a stability issue, not evidence of version drift, so it only tempers confidence slightly. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of identical resolution across machines and platforms, and documented behavior when the lockfile and package.json disagree under `--frozen-lockfile`.
